visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with an extreme close-up of a woman's face, focusing on her smooth skin texture and pink lips. She gently touches her cheek with a hand adorned with colorful bracelets. The background is a soft-focus indoor room with warm, bright lighting. Yellow text captions are centered at the bottom of the screen. (2) A transition shows a product bottle labeled "CHAI" containing a golden liquid, sitting on a dark wooden railing against a scenic outdoor background featuring distant mountains and a yellow building under a cloudy sky. Natural daylight illuminates the translucent bottle and its black pump dispenser. (3) The woman reappears in an indoor bathroom setting, wearing a fluffy white vest and a brown plush headband with bear ears. She applies a clear gel to her face, massaging it with her fingers in circular motions. The lighting is bright and white, reflecting off the moist surface of her skin. Small sparkling graphic overlays appear near her cheeks. (4) A demonstration of makeup removal is shown on a hand, where red lipstick is wiped away with a tissue, leaving clean skin. The woman then shows her face again, which appears shiny and hydrated. She holds the product bottle near her face while smiling directly at the camera lens. (5) A second bottle labeled "Oriental Beauty" is featured in the mountain setting. The woman applies the liquid to her hand and then to her face using gentle tapping motions. Text overlays highlight specific ingredients like tea polyphenols and vitamins. (6) In the final phase, the woman holds both product bottles towards the camera in a close-up shot while wearing a beige furry coat outdoors. Her expression is cheerful and persuasive. Large variety-style captions and promotional slogans populate the screen.
